name: gizza-ai/image-color-quantize
summary: Reduce an image to N colors (quantize)

tool.description: Reduce an image to at most N colors using NeuQuant quantization — an optimal palette is derived from the image itself (a posterized / retro look, and often a smaller file). colors is 2-256 (default 16). Returns a PNG. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref from a prior tool call.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

colors.description: Number of colors to reduce the image to, 2-256 (default 16). An optimal palette is derived from the image.
